name: pg-migration-verify
description: Check that Postgres/Supabase migrations were really applied: compares the objects each migration should create, alter or drop against pg_catalog. Read-only by construction.

database_url.title: Database URL
database_url.description: Postgres connection string, ideally for a dedicated read-only role. Leave empty to use $PGMV_DATABASE_URL or $DATABASE_URL from your environment.
